subject: TeraAI: CS → Ops handoff for GPU pool provisioning and autoscale policy
messages:
From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>
To: Li Wei <li.wei@teraai.com>, Jordan Matthews <jordan.matthews@teraai.com>
Cc: Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwood.ai>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 22 Apr 2027 15:12:00 +0000
Subject: TeraAI onboarding: GPU pool provisioning plan & ops handoff

Hi Li / Jordan,

Thanks again for the productive sit-down earlier — excited to get TeraAI onto Dedicated. This thread is to hand off the implementation coordination to our ops team and to lock the initial provisioning and autoscaling decisions so we can start provisioning the pool next week.

High-level ask: provision a single dedicated GPU pool (NVIDIA H100-equivalent) in us-west-2 with a baseline of 8 GPUs and burst up to 32 for scheduled model training windows. Key constraints from your side:
- Customer-managed VPC (you'll provide peering details)
- PCI scope reduction: no raw logs stored in our hosted control plane
- Expect 4k concurrent short generation requests (p95 latency target 120ms) for inference workload; larger batch training jobs will be scheduled off-peak.

Attachments: I attached the SOW draft and the preliminary network diagram. Priya will cover the routing and autoscale policy options. Grace will be the CS lead during activation.

Next steps (proposed):
1) Ops confirmation about minimum viable pool topology and network prerequisites (Markus/Ops) — due: Fri 2027-04-23 18:00 PT
2) Customer shares VPC peering CIDR + firewall policy (TeraAI) — due: Mon 2027-04-26
3) DocuSign SOW turnaround (both teams) — target: Wed 2027-04-28

Li — please confirm any additional constraints we should be aware of (data residency, retention windows, or SOC evidence requests).

Thanks,
Markus Klein
Head of Customer Implementation
Redwood Inference

---
Attachments referenced: teraai_sow_draft.pdf (SOW v0.2), network_diagram_v1.png (VPC/peering sketch)

From: Li Wei <li.wei@teraai.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>
Cc: Jordan Matthews <jordan.matthews@teraai.com>
Date: Thu, 22 Apr 2027 17:05:00 +0000
Subject: Re: TeraAI onboarding: GPU pool provisioning plan & ops handoff

Markus — thanks, this matches our notes. Couple clarifications from our side:

1) Data residency: primary workload will be us-west-2 only for now. We may add eu-west-1 later but not in initial rollout.
2) Logs: we will agree to token-level metrics only; any full request payloads must be stored in our S3 and can be pulled during audits — Redwood should not retain request payloads in the control plane.
3) Burst windows: nightly training (02:00–06:00 PT) will require additional GPUs for 6–10 hours on M/W/F depending on release cadence — can Redwood provide a predictable burst policy with advance reservation days?

We can share VPC peering details by Monday. Also attaching the onboarding checklist (we'll fill network CIDRs and firewall IPO).

- Li
Lead Infrastructure Engineer, TeraAI

From: Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwood.ai>
To: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>
Cc: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 22 Apr 2027 20:42:00 +0000
Subject: Re: TeraAI onboarding: GPU pool provisioning plan & ops handoff

Markus / team — tagging Ops (Connor) and adding a short ops play for the requested topology + autoscale options. Below are the tradeoffs and recommended defaults so we can move quickly: 

Recommendation summary:
- Baseline: 8 x H100-equivalent GPUs in a single AZ in us-west-2 for predictable network latency (we can later convert to multi-AZ if redundancy SLA requested).
- Autoscale policy: target utilization trigger at 70% sustained for 90s → scale in increments of 4 GPUs up to 32. This gives quick headroom while preserving cold-start characteristics for KV caches.
- Burst reservation: offer scheduled burst reservations (customer books 24 hrs in advance) that lock an additional N GPUs for a window. For the nightly training, propose reservation blocks of 8 GPUs for 02:00–06:00 PT on specified days.
- Caching: enable prefix KV caching for inference traffic; set TTL 45s for short-lived prompts.

Network and security asks for Ops:
- Validate peering throughput expectations (Li's team to provide CIDRs).
- BGP/route propagation not required — static peering is acceptable for initial rollout.
- Provide guidance on VPC endpoints for S3/SNS to keep artifact flow inside customer network (no egress via public internet).

Connor — can you confirm whether the current H100 fleet available in us-west-2 supports start-of-day scaling to 32 GPUs without warm-up delays? If not, we should offer a hybrid approach with pre-warmed standby nodes.

I'll draft a short runbook snippet to include in the onboarding packet and attach to the SOW.

Thanks,
Priya
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference

From: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.ai>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwood.ai>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 23 Apr 2027 09:48:00 +0000
Subject: Re: TeraAI onboarding: GPU pool provisioning plan & ops handoff

Priya / team — quick ops readout: 

- H100-equivalent capacity in us-west-2: we have inventory to guarantee baseline 8 GPUs immediately. Scaling to 32 on-demand is possible but will have a cold allocation window ~6–9 minutes depending on pod placement and local inventory churn. For guaranteed sub-2-minute availability, we need to pre-warm 8–16 standby VMs (cost tradeoff).
- For nightly training windows, recommend scheduled reservations: we can auto-provision the extra nodes at T-30 minutes when booking exists; that keeps warm-up to ~90–150s.
- We'll prepare the following artifacts for Monday: concrete CIDR and peering checklist, a network hardening note for the customer's infra team, and a short runbook for scheduled reservations.

Action items assigned:
- Connor: publish runbook + reservation play (due Mon 2027-04-26) — attachment: prod-autoscale-requirements.xlsx (draft)
- Markus/Priya: finalize SOW terms around burst pricing and pre-warm hours (target SOW v0.3)
- Li (TeraAI): share VPC details and confirm reservation cadence by Mon 2027-04-26

I'll follow up with a short Ops presentation the week of Apr 26 with the clear cost delta between on-demand burst vs pre-warm standby.

Cheers,
Connor O'Brien
Senior SRE — Dedicated Pools
Redwood Inference
